name: Chespin
description_en: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.
description_pt: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.

name: Quilladin
description_en: It relies on its sturdy shell to deflect predators’ attacks. It counterattacks with its sharp quills.
description_pt: It relies on its sturdy shell to deflect predators’ attacks. It counterattacks with its sharp quills.

name: Chesnaught
description_en: Its Tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank. It shields its allies from danger with its own body.
description_pt: Its Tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank. It shields its allies from danger with its own body.

name: Fennekin
description_en: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.
description_pt: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Braixen
description_en: It has a twig stuck in its tail. With friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on fire and launches into battle.
description_pt: It has a twig stuck in its tail. With friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on fire and launches into battle.

name: Delphox
description_en: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future.
description_pt: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future.

name: Froakie
description_en: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.
description_pt: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.

name: Frogadier
description_en: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.
description_pt: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.

name: Greninja
description_en: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.
description_pt: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.

name: Bunnelby
description_en: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.
description_pt: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.

name: Diggersby
description_en: With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders of a ton or more with ease. They can be a big help at construction sites.
description_pt: With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders of a ton or more with ease. They can be a big help at construction sites.

name: Fletchling
description_en: These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.
description_pt: These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.

name: Fletchinder
description_en: From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on the bewildered prey that pop out of the grass.
description_pt: From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on the bewildered prey that pop out of the grass.

name: Talonflame
description_en: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air.
description_pt: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air.

name: Scatterbug
description_en: When under attack from bird Pokémon, it spews a poisonous black powder that causes paralysis on contact.
description_pt: When under attack from bird Pokémon, it spews a poisonous black powder that causes paralysis on contact.

name: Spewpa
description_en: It lives hidden within thicket shadows. When predators attack, it quickly bristles the fur covering its body in an effort to threaten them.
description_pt: It lives hidden within thicket shadows. When predators attack, it quickly bristles the fur covering its body in an effort to threaten them.

name: Vivillon
description_en: Vivillon with many different patterns are found all over the world. These patterns are affected by the climate of their habitat.
description_pt: Vivillon with many different patterns are found all over the world. These patterns are affected by the climate of their habitat.

name: Litleo
description_en: The stronger the opponent it faces, the more heat surges from its mane and the more power flows through its body.
description_pt: The stronger the opponent it faces, the more heat surges from its mane and the more power flows through its body.

name: Pyroar
description_en: The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride.
description_pt: The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride.

name: Flabébé
description_en: It draws out and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower Flabébé holds is most likely part of its body.
description_pt: It draws out and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower Flabébé holds is most likely part of its body.

name: Floette
description_en: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.
description_pt: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.

name: Florges
description_en: It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from basking in the energy emitted by flowering plants.
description_pt: It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from basking in the energy emitted by flowering plants.

name: Skiddo
description_en: Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.
description_pt: Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.

name: Gogoat
description_en: It can tell how its Trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathic sense lets them run as if one being.
description_pt: It can tell how its Trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathic sense lets them run as if one being.

name: Pancham
description_en: It does its best to be taken seriously by its enemies, but its glare is not sufficiently intimidating. Chewing on a leaf is its trademark.
description_pt: It does its best to be taken seriously by its enemies, but its glare is not sufficiently intimidating. Chewing on a leaf is its trademark.

name: Pangoro
description_en: Although it possesses a violent temperament, it won’t put up with bullying. It uses the leaf in its mouth to sense the movements of its enemies.
description_pt: Although it possesses a violent temperament, it won’t put up with bullying. It uses the leaf in its mouth to sense the movements of its enemies.

name: Furfrou
description_en: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.
description_pt: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.

name: Espurr
description_en: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.
description_pt: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.

name: Meowstic
description_en: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.
description_pt: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.

name: Honedge
description_en: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.
description_pt: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.

name: Doublade
description_en: When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords, which cooperate via telepathy to coordinate attacks and slash their enemies to ribbons.
description_pt: When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords, which cooperate via telepathy to coordinate attacks and slash their enemies to ribbons.

name: Aegislash
description_en: Generations of kings were attended by these Pokémon, which used their spectral power to manipulate and control people and Pokémon.
description_pt: Generations of kings were attended by these Pokémon, which used their spectral power to manipulate and control people and Pokémon.

name: Spritzee
description_en: It emits a scent that enraptures those who smell it. This fragrance changes depending on what it has eaten.
description_pt: It emits a scent that enraptures those who smell it. This fragrance changes depending on what it has eaten.

name: Aromatisse
description_en: It devises various scents, pleasant and unpleasant, and emits scents that its enemies dislike in order to gain an edge in battle.
description_pt: It devises various scents, pleasant and unpleasant, and emits scents that its enemies dislike in order to gain an edge in battle.

name: Swirlix
description_en: To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and sticky as cotton candy.
description_pt: To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and sticky as cotton candy.

name: Slurpuff
description_en: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.
description_pt: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.

name: Inkay
description_en: Opponents who stare at the flashing of the light-emitting spots on its body become dazed and lose their will to fight.
description_pt: Opponents who stare at the flashing of the light-emitting spots on its body become dazed and lose their will to fight.

name: Malamar
description_en: It wields the most compelling hypnotic powers of any Pokémon, and it forces others to do whatever it wants.
description_pt: It wields the most compelling hypnotic powers of any Pokémon, and it forces others to do whatever it wants.

name: Binacle
description_en: Two Binacle live together on one rock. When they fight, one of them will move to a different rock.
description_pt: Two Binacle live together on one rock. When they fight, one of them will move to a different rock.

name: Barbaracle
description_en: When they evolve, two Binacle multiply into seven. They fight with the power of seven Binacle.
description_pt: When they evolve, two Binacle multiply into seven. They fight with the power of seven Binacle.

name: Skrelp
description_en: Camouflaged as rotten kelp, they spray liquid poison on prey that approaches unawares and then finish it off.
description_pt: Camouflaged as rotten kelp, they spray liquid poison on prey that approaches unawares and then finish it off.

name: Dragalge
description_en: Their poison is strong enough to eat through the hull of a tanker, and they spit it indiscriminately at anything that enters their territory.
description_pt: Their poison is strong enough to eat through the hull of a tanker, and they spit it indiscriminately at anything that enters their territory.

name: Clauncher
description_en: They knock down flying prey by firing compressed water from their massive claws like shooting a pistol.
description_pt: They knock down flying prey by firing compressed water from their massive claws like shooting a pistol.

name: Clawitzer
description_en: Their enormous claws launch cannonballs of water powerful enough to pierce tanker hulls.
description_pt: Their enormous claws launch cannonballs of water powerful enough to pierce tanker hulls.

name: Helioptile
description_en: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.
description_pt: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.

name: Heliolisk
description_en: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.
description_pt: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.

name: Tyrunt
description_en: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. If something happens that it doesn’t like, it throws a tantrum and runs wild.
description_pt: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. If something happens that it doesn’t like, it throws a tantrum and runs wild.

name: Tyrantrum
description_en: Thanks to its gargantuan jaws, which could shred thick metal plates as if they were paper, it was invincible in the ancient world it once inhabited.
description_pt: Thanks to its gargantuan jaws, which could shred thick metal plates as if they were paper, it was invincible in the ancient world it once inhabited.

name: Amaura
description_en: This ancient Pokémon was restored from part of its body that had been frozen in ice for over 100 million years.
description_pt: This ancient Pokémon was restored from part of its body that had been frozen in ice for over 100 million years.

name: Aurorus
description_en: The diamond-shaped crystals on its body expel air as cold as -240 degrees Fahrenheit, surrounding its enemies and encasing them in ice.
description_pt: The diamond-shaped crystals on its body expel air as cold as -240 degrees Fahrenheit, surrounding its enemies and encasing them in ice.

name: Sylveon
description_en: It emits a soothing aura from its ribbon-shaped organs. It wraps these appendages around quarrelers to instantly restore calm to the situation.
description_pt: It emits a soothing aura from its ribbon-shaped organs. It wraps these appendages around quarrelers to instantly restore calm to the situation.

name: Hawlucha
description_en: Although its body is small, its proficient fighting skills enable it to keep up with big bruisers like Machamp and Hariyama.
description_pt: Although its body is small, its proficient fighting skills enable it to keep up with big bruisers like Machamp and Hariyama.

name: Dedenne
description_en: Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.
description_pt: Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.

name: Carbink
description_en: Born from the temperatures and pressures deep underground, it fires beams from the stone in its head.
description_pt: Born from the temperatures and pressures deep underground, it fires beams from the stone in its head.

name: Goomy
description_en: Goomy hides away in the shade of trees, where it's nice and humid. If the slime coating its body dries out, the Pokémon instantly becomes lethargic.
description_pt: Goomy hides away in the shade of trees, where it's nice and humid. If the slime coating its body dries out, the Pokémon instantly becomes lethargic.

name: Sliggoo
description_en: A creature given to melancholy. I suspect its metallic shell developed as a result of the mucus on its skin reacting with the iron in Hisui's water.
description_pt: A creature given to melancholy. I suspect its metallic shell developed as a result of the mucus on its skin reacting with the iron in Hisui's water.

name: Goodra
description_en: Able to freely control the hardness of its metallic shell. It loathes solitude and is extremely clingy—it will fume and run riot if those dearest to it ever leave its side.
description_pt: Able to freely control the hardness of its metallic shell. It loathes solitude and is extremely clingy—it will fume and run riot if those dearest to it ever leave its side.

name: Klefki
description_en: These key collectors threaten any attackers by fiercely jingling their keys at them.
description_pt: These key collectors threaten any attackers by fiercely jingling their keys at them.

name: Phantump
description_en: These Pokémon are created when spirits possess rotten tree stumps. They prefer to live in abandoned forests.
description_pt: These Pokémon are created when spirits possess rotten tree stumps. They prefer to live in abandoned forests.

name: Trevenant
description_en: It can control trees at will. It will trap people who harm the forest, so they can never leave.
description_pt: It can control trees at will. It will trap people who harm the forest, so they can never leave.

name: Pumpkaboo
description_en: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.
description_pt: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.

name: Gourgeist
description_en: Singing in eerie voices, they wander town streets on the night of the new moon. Anyone who hears their song is cursed.
description_pt: Singing in eerie voices, they wander town streets on the night of the new moon. Anyone who hears their song is cursed.

name: Bergmite
description_en: Lives on mountains blanketed in perennial snow. It freezes water vapor in the air to make the ice helmet that it dons for defense.
description_pt: Lives on mountains blanketed in perennial snow. It freezes water vapor in the air to make the ice helmet that it dons for defense.

name: Avalugg
description_en: The armor of ice covering its lower jaw puts steel to shame and can shatter rocks with ease. This Pokémon barrels along steep mountain paths, cleaving through the deep snow.
description_pt: The armor of ice covering its lower jaw puts steel to shame and can shatter rocks with ease. This Pokémon barrels along steep mountain paths, cleaving through the deep snow.

name: Noibat
description_en: They live in pitch-black caves. Their enormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves of 200,000 hertz.
description_pt: They live in pitch-black caves. Their enormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves of 200,000 hertz.

name: Noivern
description_en: They fly around on moonless nights and attack careless prey. Nothing can beat them in a battle in the dark.
description_pt: They fly around on moonless nights and attack careless prey. Nothing can beat them in a battle in the dark.

name: Xerneas
description_en: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.
description_pt: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.

name: Yveltal
description_en: When this legendary Pokémon’s wings and tail feathers spread wide and glow red, it absorbs the life force of living creatures.
description_pt: When this legendary Pokémon’s wings and tail feathers spread wide and glow red, it absorbs the life force of living creatures.

name: Zygarde
description_en: When the Kalos region’s ecosystem falls into disarray, it appears and reveals its secret power.
description_pt: When the Kalos region’s ecosystem falls into disarray, it appears and reveals its secret power.

name: Diancie
description_en: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.
description_pt: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.

name: Hoopa
description_en: This troublemaker sends anything and everything to faraway places using its loop, which can warp space.
description_pt: This troublemaker sends anything and everything to faraway places using its loop, which can warp space.

name: Volcanion
description_en: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It’s said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.
description_pt: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It’s said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.
